method: Each final PNG was opened with view_image, or matched SHA-256 exactly to a PNG opened earlier in this review. After the final frozen palette and muted-ticker fixes, six changed light high-contrast images were opened again; the other 43 images were byte-identical to previously inspected images.

profiles.language: English fixture text; RTL layout, not translation coverage
English fixture text; RTL layout, not translation coverage

resolved_findings: Sidebar closed drawer fixed 56dp height overflow at 200% text; content now determines its height.
Approval selected and submitted check glyphs replaced with native vector marks.
Filled action-control text now uses a contrasting foreground instead of assuming light tooltip text.
Shared selected actions now have visible fill/border treatment for feedback, metrics and other accepted selections.
Normal-theme inkSubtle strengthened to light #66696f and dark #9c9fa5; all eight changed normal macOS P1/P2/P3 goldens were separately re-rendered and viewed.

Light accentInk strengthened to #0067cb; six changed light high-contrast images were separately viewed. The static captures include the muted-TickerMode action fix, but do not establish dynamic theme-transition behavior.
remaining_matrix: These two combined profiles do not cover compact dark, expanded light, medium widths, or the complete cross-product of visual dimensions.
English fixture content in RTL checks layout direction; real Arabic/Hebrew localization, punctuation conventions and glyph coverage remain separate.
Static images do not establish temporal reduced-motion behavior, hover/focus/pressed transitions, native selection handles, screen-reader output, or physical-device accessibility.
The small fixtures are representative snapshots; large-data realization, frame timing, memory, platform journeys and full interactive state matrices require their own evidence.
